summary.name: Clipstack
summary.one_liner: Clipstack is a native macOS clipboard history app with a quick panel for searching, filtering, pinning and pasting previously copied items.
use_cases: Find and re-paste text, links, images or files copied earlier
Keep reusable addresses, snippets or replies pinned for quick access
Sync clipboard history between your own Macs via iCloud
Keep clipboard history from recording passwords from password managers
summary.what_it_does: Clipstack runs in the background on macOS and records clipboard history locally. Pressing the shortcut (default ⇧⌘V) opens a quick panel that floats over other apps without taking focus, with search-as-you-type and filters for text, links, images, files and pins. Pressing return pastes the item into the app you were using, ⌥↩ pastes as plain text, and ⌘1–9 pastes the top nine items. Pinned items are kept out of history limits and appear in the menu bar with ⌥1–9. Text, code, links, images, files and colors get previews, and ⌘E edits a text item.
notable: Skips items marked as concealed or transient by password managers
Optional iCloud sync through the user's own private iCloud database, off by default
Installable via Homebrew cask; Mac App Store listing pending review
caveats: Needs Accessibility access to paste on your behalf
Mac App Store version is still in review and not yet listed
